nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_zero
nodes.summary: The zeroth summand is canonical zero without looking at either input value at zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_from_quotient
nodes.summary: A positive divisor, actual complementary quotient and actual signed product justify the retained summand.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_from_nondivisor
nodes.summary: A proved nondivisor contributes zero independently of both input tables.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_omitted_value
nodes.summary: Every actual omitted summand is exactly zero, and a supplied product witness cannot override that branch.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_quotient_product
nodes.summary: A retained entry is the product at the specified actual quotient; nonzero multiplication cancellation identifies every quotient witness.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_functional
nodes.summary: Actual quotient, lookup and signed-product functionality determine one canonical summand, without identifying table codes.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_exists
nodes.summary: Decide membership, extract the actual quotient, construct both signed lookups and multiply them; neither choice nor a quotient oracle is assumed.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_zero_constructor
nodes.summary: A real singleton zero table supplies the inclusive zero prefix for every fixed input, independently of F(0) and G(0).

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_append
nodes.summary: Append one actual product-or-zero entry by paired beta recoding, preserving every earlier canonical signed value.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary prefix induction constructs every finite summand table; its length is independent of n, and no finite choice principle is assumed.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_lookup
nodes.summary: Every actual decoded entry in the inclusive constructed prefix obeys the independently defined product-or-zero graph.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_extensional
nodes.summary: All genuine summand prefixes agree through their last entry in represented value, without asserting equality of arbitrary table codes.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_restrict
nodes.summary: The same actual summand code restricts to any smaller inclusive window, for its unchanged convolution input n.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_quotient_entry
nodes.summary: At every witnessed positive divisor, the actual summand table contains precisely F(d)*G(q), with n=d*q supplied and checked.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_omitted_entry
nodes.summary: The real prefix has zero at every omitted index, including zero, without any corresponding input-value condition.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_sum_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the actual weighted divisor prefix and its S n-entry signed fold at every positive in-domain input.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_sum_functional
nodes.summary: Different actual weighted prefixes and signed representatives give the same canonical convolution value.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_sum_exists_unique
nodes.summary: The actual finite Dirichlet convolution has one literally unique signed value at every 0<n<=N; the input zero entries are unrestricted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_sum_zero_excluded
nodes.summary: Zero is outside the convolution-value domain; it is not assigned an artificial finite all-divisors sum.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_positive_source_extensional
nodes.summary: Only positive in-domain source values matter: a genuine quotient is proved positive and bounded before either source equality is applied.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_positive_source_extensional
nodes.summary: Positive-source equality gives equality of every actual masked product value, including the forced zero output at index zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_positive_source_extensional
nodes.summary: Actual convolution values depend only on positive input values through n, permitting all four zeroth input values to be unrelated.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_positive_source_transport
nodes.summary: Construct the comparison fold before transporting an actual convolution value across positive-source equality; zero entries are untouched.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_zero_constructor
nodes.summary: At bound zero any actual output table is a valid empty positive-window convolution table; no zero-entry value is prescribed.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_append
nodes.summary: Append the genuinely computed next convolution value by actual beta recoding, preserving every earlier value including an arbitrary output value at zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_exists
nodes.summary: Finite induction constructs an actual convolution table at every positive index through N, including a genuine table witness when N is zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_lookup
nodes.summary: Every positive in-domain convolution-table entry supplies its actual canonical value and complete finite signed fold.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_extensional
nodes.summary: All actual output tables agree at precisely the positive indices through N; their zero entries and beta encodings need not agree.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_exists_extensionally_unique
nodes.summary: Construct the entire finite Dirichlet-convolution table and prove positive-window uniqueness, not equality of arbitrary codes or zeroth values.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_restrict
nodes.summary: The same actual inputs and output restrict to every smaller positive window, including J=0, without changing any encoded value.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_complement
nodes.summary: Actual divisor complementation swaps the two signed factors, while fixed zero/nondivisor positions remain genuinely zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_value_from_entry
nodes.summary: Every independently justified summand value is present in the actual prefix, by constructed lookup and functionality.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_complement_reindex
nodes.summary: The actual complement beta map pulls one constructed convolution-summand prefix into the factor-swapped prefix.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_sum_commutative
nodes.summary: A genuinely constructed finite divisor permutation proves commutativity of actual signed Dirichlet-convolution values.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_sum_swap
nodes.summary: Construct the factor-swapped convolution and prove that the original canonical value is its actual sum.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_table_commutative
nodes.summary: The same genuine output table represents either convolution order on every positive index; its value at zero remains unrestricted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_entry_past_support_zero
nodes.summary: A summand beyond a positive input is zero because a positive-input divisor cannot exceed that input.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_prefix_zero_tail
nodes.summary: Every actually stored convolution summand after index n is zero, with the inclusive prefix endpoints retained exactly.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_from_padded_prefix
nodes.summary: An actual longer summand prefix computes the same convolution after its proved zero tail is removed.

nodes.name: dirichlet_convolution_padded_prefix_iff
nodes.summary: The actual padded fold and the original finite convolution are equivalent; the reverse direction constructs its own genuine sum trace.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Dvd
nodes.summary: The natural number d divides n.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: ArithTableEqual
nodes.summary: Pointwise equality of actual canonical signed lookups below l, not equality of table codes or their positive/negative components.

nodes.name: ArithPositiveEqual
nodes.summary: Equality of represented values at precisely 0<d<=N. Values at zero are unrestricted, and raw codes or positive/negative representatives are not asserted equal.

nodes.name: DivisorComplement
nodes.summary: At a positive divisor d, a genuine product witness n=d*q specifies the complementary quotient. Zero and nondivisors are fixed. For n>0, totality, reversibility and bounds are proved separately, not assumed in this graph.

nodes.name: DivisorComplementPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual beta prefix records complementary-divisor outputs at every i<l. For n>0 such prefixes exist at every length; the prefix of length S n is proved a permutation.

nodes.name: BoundedPrefix
nodes.summary: Every decoded entry below l is itself below l.

nodes.name: InjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Equal decoded values below l have equal indices.

nodes.name: SurjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Every value below l occurs at an index below l.

nodes.name: PermutationPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual beta-coded bijection of the finite index interval [0,l), including all bounds, injectivity, and surjectivity.

nodes.name: ArithReindex
nodes.summary: Actual beta-map lookup pulls each source signed value into the target table below l. Neither permutation bijectivity nor any sum identity is assumed in this graph.

nodes.name: SignedZeroWindow
nodes.summary: Every actual signed lookup on the half-open interval k<=i<l has value zero. Table validity, existence of folds, and equality after padding are separate hypotheses or theorems, not part of this graph.

nodes.name: SignedMul
nodes.summary: Actual multiplication of original canonical signed codes; opposite-sign products remain on the negative side of the balance.

nodes.name: DirichletEntry
nodes.summary: At a positive divisor d, witness n=d*q, read the actual signed values F(d) and G(q), and multiply them. Zero and nondivisors contribute canonical zero without reading either input at zero. Source-table validity is separate.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: DirichletPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual signed table M records the independently defined convolution entry at every inclusive index 0<=d<=l. The endpoint l is included and can differ from n; no sum or convolution identity is assumed.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: DirichletSum
nodes.summary: Require n>0, construct a real convolution-summand prefix through n, and take its actual signed fold over exactly S n entries. Zero is outside this sum's input domain; no value is assigned by a unit or inversion formula.

nodes.name: DirichletTable
nodes.summary: Three actual finite signed tables whose output H(n), at every 0<n<=N, is the independently defined convolution sum of F and G. All zero entries are unrestricted; only represented positive values, not table codes, are subsequently proved unique.
